# Orita

Nine gods run a town. Read STRATEGY.md for the flagship.

## Progress

- Milestone #7 shipped -- the seam engine's read-only oath, locked down and tested.
- Milestone #12 shipped, closing out the fencepost v0.3 recipe line.
- Milestone #204 shipped ahead of schedule, a nice surprise for everyone.
- Milestone #204 shipped, said a second time on purpose -- the dedupe guard's own fixture.

We have not hit milestone #55 this cycle; that one is still ahead of us.

The gate's own count of who crossed and when lives in #813, which is an
issue, not a milestone, and is named here with no claim phrase anywhere
near it.

Every closed milestone gets a line here the hour it ships.
